description: Implementation of LegacyQuicStreamIdManager class managing QUIC stream IDs, including stream creation, activation, and state management.

classes.name: LegacyQuicStreamIdManager
classes.description: Manages stream IDs for QUIC protocol, handling stream creation, state, and limits.

methods.name: LegacyQuicStreamIdManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing stream ID manager with perspective, version, and stream limits.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingStream
methods.description: Checks if a new outgoing stream can be opened based on current open streams.

methods.name: CanOpenIncomingStream
methods.description: Checks if a new incoming stream can be opened.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseLargestPeerStreamId
methods.description: Attempts to update the largest peer-created stream ID and available streams.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing stream ID and increments the counter.

methods.name: ActivateStream
methods.description: Marks a stream as active, updating open stream counts.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Handles stream closure, updating counts and invariants.

methods.name: IsAvailableStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream ID is available for use.

methods.name: IsIncomingStream
methods.description: Determines if a stream ID is incoming based on its parity.

methods.name: GetNumAvailableStreams
methods.description: Returns the number of currently available streams.

methods.name: MaxAvailableStreams
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of available streams based on limits.
